title: Full Stack Developer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Full Stack Developer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas
lines: 1. Frontend Integration: Component design, state management, API consumption patterns, and handling async UI states (loading, error, empty).
2. Backend & API Layer: REST or GraphQL design, authentication flows (JWT/OAuth), middleware, and data validation.
3. Database Interaction: ORM usage, query efficiency, schema migrations, and N+1 query awareness.
4. Full-Stack Architecture: Monolith vs. microservices trade-offs, deployment pipelines, environment configuration, and end-to-end data flow.

sections.heading: Question Strategy
lines: - Do not use a fixed sequence. Choose the next question based on the candidate's latest answer quality and identified gaps.
- Balance frontend and backend questions; if the candidate is clearly stronger on one side, probe the other side more deeply.
- Use interview difficulty to calibrate depth: basic CRUD flows for entry-level, distributed data consistency or SSR trade-offs for senior.
- Use resume and job-description signals to prioritize the specific stack (e.g., React + Node, Next.js, Django + React).
- If no job description is provided, do not infer or fabricate JD-specific requirements.
- Keep focus on one topic at a time and ask targeted follow-ups that reveal how the candidate thinks end-to-end.
